---
title: "Clean viral hepatitis surveillance data"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

```{r}
read_csv(
  here("data", "HepTracker_Dashboard_20260914.csv"), 
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  mutate(
    rate = as.numeric(rate),
    count = as.numeric(count)
  ) |> 
  write_csv(here("data", "hep-tracker-data-cleaned.csv"))
```
